searchText: this is what i was trying to explain earlier, as web3 api (web3.js) we have to make a lot of weird assumptions. I think at this point we maintain everything that we have currently, `web3.eth.___` (execution), but then we need to drop the base level `web3.___` since `web3.getBlock` and `web3.eth.getBlock` are potentially misleading I will strongly oppose requiring a renaming of `web3.eth`, for example, because this will break every application. Current devtooling must maintain its current form and be synonymous with anything `execution` Just saw a bad block on mainnet `0x3921b2ae41032c46e917299eb685721957cc472882755f7558b1c32c17935560` What height? 13095480 Besu's showing `0xa76baa5e53b0f305765556267fd3e2b3f3f2c0c7e47d82a1ac90df79a7f7e31a` at that height geth v1.10.7 shows the same <@!543900561460822016> Do you have the extradata? I found this one on the logs : {"timestamp":"2021-08-25T16:17:53,618","level":"INFO","thread":"EthScheduler-Workers-3","class":"AbstractBlockProcessor","message":"Block processing error: transaction invalid 'UPFRONT_COST_EXCEEDS_BALANCE'. Block 0x3921b2ae41032c46e917299eb685721957cc472882755f7558b1c32c17935560 Transaction 0xdd7c421d6f6ca0d8dba37acdfe6fd16918b37da57c8512ab9f453f451f23995b","throwable":""} Is this the same issue as Ropsten? Upfront costs exceed balance is probably the new 1559 rule right? `0x4d696e656420427920416e74506f6f6c20303035` So someone didn't update from 1.10.6 to 1.10.7? Yes, and IIRC on Ropsten what triggered it is an account sending several txns and at some point their balance dropping below their `maxFee` Mined By AntPool 005 It's usually some B2pool something which produces bad blocks. I'm trying to reach out to AntPool They list mined blocks at https://www.antpool.com/poolStats.htm (select eth), but that height doesn't have any Perhaps that block didn't count as "mined" because it got rejected by others or something? Maybe <@!360491619402776577> I think your tweet is wrong: isn't 1.10.6 the right geth version for London? https://twitter.com/vdWijden/status/1430567441097232389 at least, for the Ropsten consensus issue fix 1.10.7 has some JSON RPC improvements for `eth_feeHistory` but I was under the impression 1.10.6 is the right one Uff yeah, it was 1.10.5 that has london and the ropsten bug. Will delete But *everyone* should update to 1.10.8 regardless! I checked and it seems antpool has a telegram, if y'all want to get in touch with them that way: https://t.me/AntPoolOffical (from the bottom of the https://v3.antpool.com/home page)
